maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from exhibitor booth and sponsorship sales at trade shows and media, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Exhibitors, sponsors and attendees are private businesses paying for B2B trade show events and media properties.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own trade shows and organic growth; acquisitions of events occur but aren't the main growth engine.

mission_critical.reason: Exhibitors can shift marketing spend to other trade shows or channels; though flagship shows have network effects, switching is easy.

notes: Serial acquirer is a judgment call; Emerald has bought shows regularly since its 2017 IPO but also grows organically.
